mapper.sql: id, user_id, title, start_date, end_date, cover_image_url, cover_style, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM diaries WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY start_date DESC, id DESC

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.cover_image_url, d.cover_style, COUNT(p.id) AS page_count FROM diaries d LEFT JOIN diary_pages p ON p.diary_id = d.id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY d.id, d.title, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.cover_image_url, d.cover_style ORDER BY d.start_date DESC, d.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diaries ( user_id, title, start_date, end_date, cover_image_url, cover_style, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{coverImageUrl}, #{coverStyle}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE diaries SET title = #{title}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, cover_image_url = #{coverImageUrl}, cover_style = #{coverStyle}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
